looks.label: three-layer loading card
looks.technique: full-bleed background layer declared at 1024x768 and anchored corner to corner; small emblem anchored to the bottom edge with a 10 px offset; small corner caption anchored bottom-left; all in one artwork layer

looks.label: nine-piece engine backdrop
looks.technique: one tiled background piece plus four edge strips and four corner pieces, each its own texture with the UI image mode

looks.label: plain UI texture pass
looks.technique: fragment shader samples the texture and returns it unchanged; no tint, glow, fog or fresnel, so the look comes from art, not the shader

originals.name: Tip card loading screen
originals.idea: a loading screen with a full-bleed backdrop, one low centred emblem, a rotating tip in the corner slot and a progress bar under it
originals.keep: three stacked layers, one low focal point, one small caption slot
originals.change: our own backdrop art and emblem, tip text instead of a version string, progress bar added; clean-room, never copied

originals.name: Nine-piece menu backdrop kit
originals.idea: one tiled background piece plus eight edge and corner pieces so one kit frames any panel
originals.change: our own corner ornament and our palette

originals.name: HUD layout as a data tree with script hooks
originals.idea: HUD anchors and sizes declared as data, behaviour attached by script
originals.keep: the anchor and size vocabulary, behaviour kept out of the layout
originals.change: a typed TypeScript or JSON tree for our HUD instead of XML; the catalogue becomes its runtime source

originals.name: Stub-first audio surface
originals.idea: every audio call exists so scripts run without crashing when sound is missing
originals.change: stubs log once and return real handles, so a missing cue shows in the build instead of passing silently
